from hermes_tools import write_file, terminal
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs/task-62961254.py'
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # 4-valued full rows/columns are the compartment boundaries.
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cs + [w]
    boxes = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
             for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    # Select the compartment containing the most non-background, non-divider cells.
    scores = [sum(grid[r][c] not in (4, 9) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
              for r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes]
    k = max(range(len(boxes)), key=lambda i: scores[i])
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = boxes[k]
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in boxes:
        if (b-a, y-x) == (r1-r0, c1-c0):
            for i in range(b-a):
                out[a+i][x:y] = pattern[i][:]
    return out
'''
print(write_file(p,s))
